macros.name: inconsolatanffamily
macros.doc: A font family for the Inconsolata Nerd Font, the default variant provided by this package.

macros.name: inconsolatanfmonofamily
macros.doc: A font family for the Inconsolata Nerd Font, the mono variant provided by this package.

macros.name: inconsolatanfpropofamily
macros.doc: A font family for the Inconsolata Nerd Font, the propo variant provided by this package.

macros.name: textinconsolatanf
macros.doc: A convenience macro to typeset a short text using the default Inconsolata Nerd Font variant.

macros.name: textinconsolatanfmono
macros.doc: A convenience macro to typeset a short text using the mono Inconsolata Nerd Font variant.

macros.name: textinconsolatanfpropo
macros.doc: A convenience macro to typeset a short text using the propo Inconsolata Nerd Font variant.
